_comment: Opt-in review provenance: all five provenance strings plus the review retrieved_at epoch, the exact TTL constant, and applicable true. Review stale is deliberately not pinned (clock-dependent); availability stale false is pinned. REDs before impl: startup rejects metadata_source.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
metadata_source = "opencode-go-v1"

[catalog.model_providers]
"glm-5.3-flash" = "chatup"

client_text_contains: "verification":"reviewed provider-specific Models.dev records; not authenticated inference verification"

name: m4_catalog_capability_provenance_ttl
